dsm-004.journal_kind_note: 72 fault-schedule events = 36 inbox deliver (all disposition=accepted) + 36 outbox send; 10 recovery journal events are kind=transition (values: running x6, failed x3, succeeded x1). deliver_accepted/send counts above refer to fault schedules only.
dsm-004.contamination_group_note: All six fault-schedule outbox journals are hash-identical (same event hashes) -> single shared group dsm004:outbox-shared so identical records cannot straddle a split. Inbox journals differ per schedule -> per-schedule groups. Recovery scenario records share the group of their journal lineage (retries/duplicates/replays stay together per protocol split policy).

vq-002.basis: size-estimate (preflight SS1); exact 50 for adequate.part0 (50/50 lines read)
vq-002.DUPLICATION_WARNING: outcomes-adequate.part0 and outcomes-degraded.part0 have IDENTICAL blob SHA e79f2946fd30cc11994a2015f35668fb4e9ab808; adequate.part1 == degraded.part1 (2fdc9b28d8f0814b7e579bc03fddfa18e55148c9); part2 differs (adequate e14239f8... vs degraded 8d7c4b0c...) but shares the same 30 case_ids bad0-bad29 with 20/30 content-identical records. The adequate/degraded split is therefore NOT in the record payloads for parts 0-1 (likely a verifier-condition wrapper, see vq-002-benchmark.json sha 27002ad6c3a15f20b638a09dfb914c73fc3ad862 -- not yet inventoried into corpus). Contamination groups are keyed by case_id lineage (vq:case:<case_id>) so ALL variants of a case -- adequate/degraded, identical or verdict-flipped -- share one group and can never straddle a split (SLM-INFRA-QUAL MATERIAL-2 fix; supersedes the prior blob-sha8 keying, which assigned part2 pairs to different groups). Near-duplicate records across adequate/degraded parts 0-1 are expected and must still be deduplicated or single-sided before any split.
vq-002.verification_status_rule: ground_truth == verdict -> verified_success else verified_failure; null verdict/ground_truth -> unknown

contamination_group_scheme.otx: otx:<task_class>-<granularity> (6 groups; all replicates of a task family share group)
contamination_group_scheme.vq: vq:case:<case_id> -- case_id LINEAGE-keyed (SLM-INFRA-QUAL MATERIAL-2 fix). All variants of a case across adequate/degraded parts share one group, including the 30 shared part2 case_ids bad0-bad29 whose blob SHAs differ (e14239f8 vs 8d7c4b0c) despite 20/30 content-identical records. Supersedes the prior vq:<prefix>:<blob-sha8> scheme, which assigned those identical records to different groups and admitted split straddling.
contamination_group_scheme.dsm: dsm004:<schedule> for fault inboxes; dsm004:outbox-shared for hash-identical outbox journals; dsm004:recovery/<scenario> (journal + scenario record share lineage)
contamination_group_scheme.total_groups_estimated: recomputed on first converter execution; VQ group count now equals the number of distinct case_ids (one group per case, variants merged), not per part-file
contamination_group_scheme.total_groups_basis: manual-inspection: 6 OTX + 1 OBS + 10 DSM + 5 RUNTIME + VQ (one group per distinct case_id; exact count pending full read of parts 1-2)
